title: e-KTP whose records you can trust
description: e-KTP whose records you can trust: a monthly audit approach, what to check on each entry and how to fix gaps before they pile up.
answer: When it matters, e-KTP lives in three places, and the first one you open is already stale. IDMark keeps e-KTP on-device, so it stays readable with no data plan and no account.

sections.p: When it matters, e-KTP lives in three places, and the first one you open is already stale.
Keep one card with contacts, location, and key numbers that opens without a signal.
If you miss several days, do not wipe history. Open the last entry, fill in one day, then close.

list: Pick one fixed time, not “whenever there is room”.
Open IDMark when that time arrives, not later tonight.
Note one blocker, not a long excuse.
Back up before you switch phones.
faqs: Yes. IDMark keeps everything on-device, so no data plan is needed.
Do I need an account first?
No. Start without login; export a backup from time to time.
With the shortest piece. Add scope only after two steady weeks.
What if I miss a few days?
Do not wipe history. Resume from the last entry and note one blocker.
